name: Big Bend National Park
tagline: Big Bend — desert mountains and Rio Grande; pick one short area, not the whole park.
blurb: West Texas desert day — one basin or river stop, heat-smart.
slice: Panther Junction / Chisos area short stops
art: Big Bend desert mountains and Rio Grande canyon under huge Texas sky

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; services sparse.
practical.transit_note: Long drives from cities; stock water and fuel.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → one overlook or short basin walk

name: Biscayne National Park
tagline: Biscayne — mostly water; visitor center and jetty/shore when not on a boat.
blurb: Bay park day — shore and visitor center if you skip boat tours.
art: Biscayne turquoise bay water with mangroves and soft Florida sky

practical.ticket_note: Shore free; boat tours extra and seasonal.
practical.transit_note: Homestead / Miami area.
practical.energy_note: Sun, bugs, limited shade on water.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → jetty/shore walk → exhibits

name: Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
tagline: Black Canyon — South Rim overlooks; stay behind rails on sheer drops.
blurb: Deep dark canyon day — rim pullouts, not the inner canyon.
art: Black Canyon of the Gunnison steep dark cliffs and narrow river far below

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass.
practical.transit_note: Montrose gateway; South Rim is main family slice.
practical.energy_note: Altitude + sheer cliffs — hold hands at rails.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → two rim overlooks

name: Canyonlands National Park
tagline: Canyonlands — Island in the Sky overlooks; one mesa, not all districts.
blurb: Mesa top day near Moab — big views from short walks.
art: Canyonlands Island in the Sky mesa overlook with layered red canyons

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; districts far apart.
practical.transit_note: Moab; Island in the Sky is closest for most families.
practical.energy_note: Sun and exposure; no shade at many rails.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → Mesa Arch or Grand View area short stop
practical.season_note: Hot summers; combine carefully with Arches crowds.

name: Carlsbad Caverns National Park
tagline: Carlsbad — Big Room cave (self-guided or tour) and visitor center.
blurb: Cave day — cool underground loop; bat flight seasonal evenings.
art: Carlsbad Caverns huge cave chamber with stalactites soft blue lighting

practical.ticket_note: Timed entry tickets often required for cave.
practical.transit_note: Carlsbad NM gateway; elevator or natural entrance.
practical.energy_note: Lots of walking underground; jacket helps.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → cave entry → Big Room pace
practical.season_note: Bat flight program seasonal; check tickets.

name: Channel Islands National Park
tagline: Channel Islands — mainland visitor center if not on a boat day.
blurb: Island park — plan boat transit; or do mainland exhibits only.
slice: Ventura visitor center (or one island if boating)
art: Channel Islands coastal cliffs and blue Pacific with island silhouette

practical.ticket_note: Boat to islands is separate concession; weather dependent.
practical.transit_note: Ventura / Oxnard harbors.
practical.best_start: Mainland visitor center → harbor look → island only if booked

name: Crater Lake National Park
tagline: Crater Lake — rim overlooks of the deep blue caldera; rim drive seasonal.
blurb: Caldera view day — short rim walks, not a full rim drive marathon.
art: Crater Lake deep blue caldera water and snowy rim cliffs

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass.
practical.transit_note: Long mountain access roads; snow into summer some years.
practical.energy_note: Altitude and cold wind on rim.
practical.best_start: Rim Village visitor area → two overlooks
practical.season_note: Rim Drive often closed late fall–early summer.

name: Denali National Park
tagline: Denali — park entrance / visitor center day; buses needed for deeper park.
blurb: Alaska gateway day — visitor center and short trails near the entrance.
art: Denali massive snowy mountain peak over tundra and spruce

practical.ticket_note: Entrance fee; park road buses are the deep-park option.
practical.transit_note: Parks Highway; most family time is near entrance without a bus.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → short trail → exhibits
practical.season_note: Peak summer only for most services; mountain often clouded.

name: Dry Tortugas National Park
tagline: Dry Tortugas — ferry or seaplane day to Fort Jefferson; plan transit first.
blurb: Fort and reef day — only if you booked the boat/plane.
art: Dry Tortugas brick fort in turquoise water with tropical sky

practical.ticket_note: Ferry/seaplane tickets required and sell out.
practical.transit_note: From Key West only; rough seas possible.
practical.energy_note: Sun, limited shade, bring all water/food per boat rules.
practical.best_start: Arrive Garden Key → fort walls → beach/snorkel zone if open

name: Great Basin National Park
tagline: Great Basin — Wheeler Peak scenic drive and short alpine or cave options.
blurb: Nevada mountain day — overlooks and bristlecones if open.
slice: Visitor center / Wheeler Peak road short stops
art: Great Basin mountain peaks and starry-feeling high desert night tones soft daylight version

practical.ticket_note: Park free; Lehman Caves tours ticketed.
practical.transit_note: Remote Baker NV; fuel up early.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → scenic drive pullout or cave tour
practical.season_note: High road seasonal; dark skies famous at night.

name: Great Sand Dunes National Park
tagline: Great Sand Dunes — dune field edge and Medano Creek when flowing.
blurb: Sand mountain day — play at the dune base; summit is optional hard work.
art: Great Sand Dunes golden sand mountains with Sangre de Cristo peaks behind

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass.
practical.transit_note: Mosca / Alamosa area.
practical.energy_note: Sand is exhausting; sun extreme; shoes heat up.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → dune edge play → creek if flowing
practical.season_note: Creek peak late spring; summer storms.

name: Guadalupe Mountains National Park
tagline: Guadalupe Mountains — visitor center and short desert foothill walks.
blurb: West Texas mountain day — easy trails near HQ, not Guadalupe Peak summit.
art: Guadalupe Mountains rugged desert peaks and Chihuahuan Desert scrub

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass.
practical.transit_note: Remote on US-62/180; no gas in park.
practical.energy_note: Heat and wind; peak hikes are hard.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → short foothill path → overlook if any
practical.season_note: Summer very hot; winter can be icy on peaks.

name: Haleakalā National Park
tagline: Haleakalā — summit crater views; reservations often required for sunrise.
blurb: Maui volcano day — summit overlooks or coastal Kipahulu, not both casually.
art: Haleakala volcanic crater summit with cinder cones and soft sunrise colors

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; sunrise vehicles often need reservation.
practical.transit_note: Long winding drive to summit; cold at top.
practical.energy_note: Altitude + cold wind; dress in layers.
practical.best_start: Summit visitor area → crater overlooks
practical.season_note: Clouds common; Kipahulu is a separate long drive.

name: Kings Canyon National Park
tagline: Kings Canyon — Grant Grove big trees; pair carefully with Sequoia.
blurb: Giant sequoia grove day on the Kings side — short paved loops.
art: Kings Canyon Grant Grove giant sequoia trunks in sunlit forest

practical.ticket_note: Same SEKI entrance pass as Sequoia.
practical.transit_note: Grant Grove is the easy Kings Canyon family slice.
practical.best_start: Grant Grove visitor area → big tree loop
practical.season_note: Snow can close roads; summer easiest.

name: Lassen Volcanic National Park
tagline: Lassen — hydrothermal boardwalks and peak views when road is open.
blurb: Volcano park day — Bumpass Hell-style boardwalks if open, or lake stops.
art: Lassen Volcanic steaming geothermal boardwalk and volcanic peaks

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass.
practical.transit_note: Main park road often snow-closed late into summer.
practical.energy_note: Stay on boardwalks near thermal areas.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → hydrothermal boardwalk or lake overlook

name: Mesa Verde National Park
tagline: Mesa Verde — cliff dwelling overlooks; many tours need tickets.
blurb: Ancestral Pueblo cliff day — overlooks and museum; ladders only if tour-ready.
art: Mesa Verde cliff dwelling alcoves in sandstone canyon walls

practical.ticket_note: Some dwelling tours ticketed and strenuous.
practical.transit_note: Cortez / Mancos area; mesa roads windy.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → overlook of dwellings → museum

name: Mount Rainier National Park
tagline: Mount Rainier — Paradise or Sunrise wildflower/views; one entrance only.
blurb: Volcano view day — short paved paths with the mountain as backdrop.
art: Mount Rainier snowy volcano peak above wildflower meadows

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; timed entry possible peak season.
practical.transit_note: Ashford / Paradise is classic family slice.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → short paved meadow path → viewpoint

name: New River Gorge National Park
tagline: New River Gorge — canyon rim overlooks and bridge views.
blurb: West Virginia gorge day — rim walks and the famous bridge vista.
art: New River Gorge bridge and deep green river canyon

practical.ticket_note: Generally free.
practical.transit_note: Near Fayetteville / Lansing WV.
practical.best_start: Canyon Rim visitor center → bridge overlook boardwalk
practical.season_note: Bridge Day special event crowds in October.

name: North Cascades National Park
tagline: North Cascades — highway overlooks and short lakeside stops.
blurb: Alpine highway day — Diablo/Ross area views without a multi-day backpack.
art: North Cascades sharp jagged peaks and turquoise alpine lake

practical.ticket_note: Many overlooks free along highway.
practical.transit_note: SR-20 seasonal in winter east of park complex.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → lake overlook → short path

name: Pinnacles National Park
tagline: Pinnacles — rock spires and short cave or bench trails; one entrance.
blurb: Central Coast rock day — easy valley trails and spire views.
slice: East or West entrance short trail (pick one)
art: Pinnacles National Park volcanic rock spires and oak-studded hills

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; no road connects east/west inside park.
practical.transit_note: Choose one entrance and stay there.
practical.energy_note: Heat in summer; talus caves dark and uneven.
practical.best_start: Visitor contact → short valley trail → spire viewpoint

name: Voyageurs National Park
tagline: Voyageurs — water park; visitor center and short shore trails without a boat.
blurb: Northwoods lake day — shore and exhibits if you skip boat access.
art: Voyageurs lake country with rocky islands and northern forest

practical.ticket_note: Shore free; boat needed for most interior.
practical.transit_note: International Falls area visitor centers.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → shore boardwalk or dock views
practical.season_note: Winter ice travel is specialist; summer boats.

name: White Sands National Park
tagline: White Sands — dune drive and sled hills of gypsum sand.
blurb: White dune day — short walks and play; check missile-range closures.
art: White Sands endless white gypsum dunes under blue New Mexico sky

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; occasional full park closures for tests.
practical.transit_note: Alamogordo / Holloman area.
practical.energy_note: Sun glare extreme; sunglasses and water.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → Dunes Drive → play/hike short
practical.season_note: Check NPS for closure alerts before driving out.

name: Wind Cave National Park
tagline: Wind Cave — cave tour plus prairie wildlife above ground.
blurb: Cave + prairie day — tour underground, then look for bison from the road.
slice: Visitor center cave tour + prairie drive
art: Wind Cave prairie hills with bison and a cave entrance hillside

practical.ticket_note: Cave tours ticketed; sell out.
practical.transit_note: Near Hot Springs SD; close to Black Hills.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → cave tour → short prairie pullouts

name: Glacier Bay National Park
tagline: Glacier Bay — usually a cruise or boat day; Bartlett Cove if you fly in.
blurb: Tidewater glacier park — plan transport first; shore options limited.
slice: Bartlett Cove / visitor facilities if accessible
art: Glacier Bay tidewater glacier calving into blue-gray water with mountains

practical.ticket_note: Most visits via cruise or tour boat.
practical.transit_note: Fly to Gustavus or boat only; no road from mainland highway.
practical.best_start: If ashore: visitor center → shore trail; if boat: deck wildlife watch
practical.season_note: Peak summer only for most services.

name: Kenai Fjords National Park
tagline: Kenai Fjords — Exit Glacier area short trails near Seward.
blurb: Glacier edge day — Exit Glacier trails without a full fjord cruise.
slice: Exit Glacier / Harding Icefield trailhead area
art: Kenai Fjords Exit Glacier blue ice and rocky moraine near mountain

practical.ticket_note: Exit Glacier area accessible by road; boat tours extra.
practical.transit_note: Seward AK.
practical.energy_note: Cold wind near ice; stay off glacier ice without guides.
practical.best_start: Nature center → short glacier view trail

name: Katmai National Park
tagline: Katmai — famous for bears at Brooks Falls; fly-in only for most visitors.
blurb: Bear viewing park — logistics-heavy; not a casual drive-up day.
art: Katmai Brooks Falls with brown bears fishing stylized friendly distant view

practical.ticket_note: Complex permits/lodging/day use in peak bear season.
practical.transit_note: Fly from King Salmon; no road system.
practical.best_start: Only with booked access: falls platform → camp trails
practical.season_note: July peak for salmon/bears; book far ahead.

name: Isle Royale National Park
tagline: Isle Royale — wilderness island; ferry required, multi-day for most.
blurb: Lake Superior island — only with ferry plans; mainland info centers help prepare.
slice: Rock Harbor or Windigo if ferrying (else mainland prep)
art: Isle Royale rocky Lake Superior shore with boreal forest and clear water

practical.ticket_note: Ferry required; park is remote wilderness.
practical.transit_note: Ferries from MI/MN; weather cancellations.
practical.best_start: If on island: visitor contact → short shore trail
practical.season_note: Summer only for ferries; closed in winter.

name: National Park of American Samoa
tagline: American Samoa — tropical rainforest and reef; local access and cultural respect.
blurb: South Pacific park day — short village-linked trails when open.
art: American Samoa tropical rainforest meeting turquoise reef water

practical.ticket_note: Free; some trails cross village lands — follow local guidance.
practical.transit_note: Tutuila island access only via international travel.
practical.best_start: Visitor information → one short coastal or forest trail

name: Virgin Islands National Park
tagline: Virgin Islands — St. John beaches and easy shore trails.
blurb: Caribbean park day — beach + short trail; ferry from St. Thomas common.
slice: Cruz Bay / Trunk Bay area short stop
art: Virgin Islands turquoise bay beach with green hills

practical.ticket_note: Beach fees may apply some sites; park free to enter.
practical.transit_note: Ferry to St. John; taxis/jeeps on island.
practical.best_start: Cruz Bay visitor contact → one beach + short path
practical.season_note: Hurricane season mid-year; peak winter tourism.

name: Gates of the Arctic National Park
tagline: Gates of the Arctic — true wilderness; no roads or trails system for casual visits.
blurb: Remote Brooks Range park — expedition-level only; use info centers to learn.
art: Gates of the Arctic remote tundra mountains and endless arctic light

practical.ticket_note: No entrance station; access is fly-in wilderness.
practical.transit_note: No park roads; bush plane required.
practical.energy_note: Full wilderness skills required — not a toddler outing.
practical.best_start: Prep at regional visitor centers; only enter with guided/expedition plan
practical.slice_name: Gateway prep only for most families

name: Kobuk Valley National Park
tagline: Kobuk Valley — arctic sand dunes; fly-in wilderness access only.
blurb: Remote northwest Alaska — expedition access, not a drive-up kit.
art: Kobuk Valley arctic sand dunes and tundra under wide northern sky

practical.ticket_note: No road access; charters required.
practical.transit_note: Kotzebue hub then bush plane.
practical.best_start: Regional visitor center education stop unless on guided trip

name: Lake Clark National Park
tagline: Lake Clark — fly-in lakes and volcanoes; Port Alsworth is the tiny hub.
blurb: Remote lake park — plane access; short shore walks if you make it in.
slice: Port Alsworth shore / visitor contact if available
art: Lake Clark blue mountain lake with volcano peak and spruce shore

practical.ticket_note: Fly-in; limited lodging.
practical.transit_note: Air taxi from Anchorage area hubs.
practical.best_start: If in Port Alsworth: visitor contact → shore path

name: Wrangell–St. Elias National Park
tagline: Wrangell–St. Elias — enormous park; visitor center and one road-accessible slice.
blurb: Biggest US park — Copper Center exhibits + McCarthy road only if prepared.
art: Wrangell St Elias vast mountain range and glacier valley

practical.ticket_note: Visitor centers free; remote roads rough.
practical.transit_note: Richardson Highway visitor center is the easy win.
practical.energy_note: McCarthy Road is long gravel — not casual with toddlers.
practical.best_start: Copper Center visitor center → short interpretive path
